\section[respetar]{respetar — to respect}

\label{lesson:ES-C500-respetar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for to feel like, then the Spanish for to share.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: respetar}
\textbf{respetar} — \textquotedblleft{}to respect\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Respeta el horario de descanso.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Respect the quiet hours.}
\end{quote}

The verb behind \emph{el respeto}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for reading notices, forms and messages.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{respetar}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{respetar}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Spanish for to feel like, then the Spanish for to share, then say \emph{respetar} again
\end{itemize}

What does respetar mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To respect\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: molestar}
